items.author: André Cabrita-Mendes, José Carlos Lourinho
items.title: Web Summit deverá fechar na quarta-feira, anuncia autarquia de Lisboa
items.quote: Tudo indica que a Web Summit não poderá funcionar amanhã
items.note: Storm Charles, red wind warning. Moedas says event likely cannot run Wednesday 11 Nov, final call with the Interior Ministry (MAI). Web Summit says it is assessing with ANEPC. Text says 'quarta-feira, 10 de novembro' in places: typo, means 11 Nov.

items.author: Negócios (live blog, several reporters and Lusa)
items.title: Aeroportos condicionados, 4.000 clientes sem eletricidade. Governo recomenda suspensão da Web Summit
items.note: Live blog, updated 18:25. Government recommends suspending Wed 11 Nov; PM says organisers decide. Water entered one pavilion on Tuesday; many participants left early. National alert 00:00-23:59 Wed; red wind warning in 8 districts incl. Lisboa; airports restricted; sting jet not ruled out; about 4,000 E-Redes customers without power at 16:30.

items.author: CNN Portugal (live blog)
items.title: Mau tempo AO MINUTO | Governo declara situação de alerta: escolas e serviços públicos não essenciais encerrados
items.note: Entry 17:49: government recommends the organisers suspend activities on Wednesday due to storm Charles; PM: the decision is theirs. Page last update seen 18:42. | Re-read 07:51: 07:24, about ten cars partly submerged in Parque das Nações (the venue's district).

items.author: LPP editorial team
items.title: Tempestade Charles em Lisboa esta quarta-feira. O que esperar?

Interior minister said no change planned to the event at that time of writing.

websummit_terms: Since 2026-11-11T12:53Z: websummit.com is no longer read by machine (Web Summit's Terms 48.2 and 52.1 forbid automated reading, found by Dinis's incident team, which stopped at 05:27 UTC on 11 November). Earlier items from websummit.com were read by machine between 10 November 18:45 and 11 November 12:52 UTC and stay as the record; new Web Summit word comes through the press and the organisers' public posts.
web_summit_data_rule: Since 2026-11-11T14:52Z: no new work built on Web Summit-derived data (its agenda's sessions, people, organisations, places; Vicky's desks record Dinis's 'yes, dont use them', about 14:30 UTC). Nothing earlier is deleted or changed until Dinis says what to do with it.
licence_note: This is not everything. Web Summit's licence does not let us republish data from its site, so on 11 November 2026 we took off whatever rested only on it (Dinis, about 18:50 UTC: board/guidance/2026-11-11-only-websummit-sourced-comes-off.md). What remains has another public source, cited; an item comes back when we find one (the shadow method: https://newsroom.sgit.ai/articles/sources-and-shadows.html).
